module.name: RTT Tic-Tac-Toe Bot
module.summary: Triadic unit-test bot: tiny state space, replayable timeline, schema-valid snapshot.

module.name: RTT Tic-Tac-Toe
module.summary: Triadic interpretation of a 3x3 game tree using the shared RTT envelope.
module.purpose: Serve as the build-gate unit test for the TriadicFrameworks suite.
module.audience: Framework authors, engine integrators, test harnesses

steps: Lumen: extract winning lines, threat lines, fork opportunities
Hephaestus: classify legal moves as local / structural / continuity; enforce sum-to-1 proportions
Aurion: compute ancestry (win paths, draw paths, loss paths)
Harmonia: compute triadic score using published weights; derive final score
StateEmitter: emit shared RTT envelope; validate against schema

integration_surface.mode: pure RTT evaluation (no external game engine)

examples.description: Legal 7-ply position: O threatens A3 (local win), X threatens B3 (continuity). Demonstrates threat-lines, regime proportions, projection-loss, and continuity potential.

context.drift: Conformance-first; tiny state space used to validate RTT invariants.
context.coherence: All bots must emit the shared RTT envelope: metadata, timeline, snapshot, lumen, regime, ancestry, risk, drift, triadic_score, winner.
